messages.subject: nls2_0.2
parts: I think, the current version of the program available from CRAN does not appear to have the "plinear-brute" algorithm available to implement. Is this right?

messages.author: 17e30776ec2a7fb1
messages.subject: Re: nls2_0.2
parts:
On Wednesday, September 4, 2013 10:10:44 AM UTC-4, jackbl...@googlemail.com wrote:
I think, the current version of the program available from CRAN does not appear to have the "plinear-brute" algorithm available to implement. Is this right?

It is present.  Here is an example:

> library(nls2)
> example(nls2)   # set up data used in next statement
> fm <- nls2(fo, data = pastured, start = gstart, alg = "plinear-brute")
... numerous error messages which can be ignored ...
> fm
Nonlinear regression model
  model:  yield ~ cbind(1, -exp(-exp(t3 + t4 * log(time)))) 
   data:  pastured 
      t3       t4    .lin1    .lin2 
  -7.143    1.000 1212.071 1213.148 
 residual sum-of-squares: 71.87
 > packageVersion("nls2")
[1] ‘0.2’

parts:
On Wednesday, September 4, 2013 10:40:47 AM UTC-4, jackbl...@googlemail.com wrote:
For sure but the version I get from the zip file is 1.3

The version on CRAN 

   http://cran.r-project.org/package=nls2

is 0.2 and that is the version you should be getting when you do 

   install.packages("nls2") 
   library(nls2)
   packageVersion("nls2")
